press_references.value: Bunkerhill Secures FDA Clearance for ECG-EF, Using AI to Detect Reduced Ejection Fraction from Routine ECGs

product_launches.description: Bunkerhill Health secured FDA clearance and launched ECG-EF—an AI algorithm that detects reduced left ventricular ejection fraction from routine 12‑lead ECGs—within its Carebricks platform. Developed by Carelog, the launch adds ECG as a new input modality for Bunkerhill.

overview_description.description: Bunkerhill Health develops artificial intelligence software and clinical workflow solutions for healthcare organizations. Its Carebricks platform enables health systems to create, deploy, and manage AI agents for clinical and operational use cases. The company also supports the validation, regulatory clearance, licensing, and implementation of AI algorithms to facilitate their adoption in clinical settings. In addition, it collaborates with healthcare providers and academic medical centers to evaluate and integrate AI technologies into patient care workflows. Its products and services focus on improving clinical decision-making, operational efficiency, and the deployment of artificial intelligence across health systems.

about_short_description.short_description: Bunkerhill Health develops AI agents aimed at enhancing clinical and operational teams within health systems.

product.name: Carebricks
product.description: An AI platform for health systems that interprets EHR, imaging, laboratory, and clinical-note data to identify risks, determine appropriate next steps, and automate follow-up workflows.

product.name: Carebricks Chat
product.description: A conversational interface that lets clinicians query a patient’s longitudinal record and receive context-rich answers grounded in EHR data, imaging, laboratory results, notes, guidelines, and research.

identifier.value: FDA-Cleared AI Imaging and Clinical Algorithms

product.name: FDA-Cleared AI Imaging and Clinical Algorithms
product.description: A portfolio of FDA-cleared algorithms that analyze routine medical images or ECGs to detect and quantify findings such as coronary calcium, valve calcification, low bone density, aortic enlargement, mitral annular calcification, and reduced ejection fraction.

identifier.value: Custom AI Workflow Design and Deployment

product.name: Custom AI Workflow Design and Deployment
product.description: A service for health systems to configure and deploy AI agents for clinical and operational use cases, including finding patient cohorts, applying rules, and coordinating automated actions across specialties.

product.name: Automated Clinical Registry Management
product.description: A Carebricks-based registry service that identifies reportable cases, extracts and validates required data, prepares submissions, and triggers follow-up actions across oncology and other clinical registries.
